In addition to playing a role in several quests, the village is popular for its [[player-owned house]] portal, which players use to train [[Prayer]] by [[Bank note|un-noting]] [[Bones (disambiguation)|bones]] with [[Phials]] and then using them on a [[gilded altar]]. ==Transportation== Many transport options bring players into or close to Rimmington, listed here with their arrival destination. * {{Plink|Teleport to House}} — Rimmington [[house portal]]. Requires a [[POH]] in the village. * {{Plink|Construct. cape|txt=Construction cape}} or {{Plink|Rimmington teleport}} — Rimmington house portal. * {{Plink|Ardougne Teleport}} — Ardougne docks, which offer a trip to Rimmington for 30 [[coins]]. * {{Plink|Skills necklace}} can teleport players to the [[Crafting Guild]] north of the village. * {{Plink|Balloon transport system|pic=Orange balloon}} can bring players to the Crafting Guild. * {{Plink|Crafting cape}} — Crafting Guild. * Charter a ship to [[Corsair Cove]], then speak to [[Captain Tock]] ([[Cabin Boy Colin]] after completion of [[The Corsair Curse]]) to reach Rimmington. * {{Plink|Minigame Teleport}} to [[Rat Pits]] - [[Port Sarim]] (wily cats), east of Rimmington (requires [[Ratcatchers]]); Minigame Teleport recharges every 20 minutes. * {{Plink|Spirit trees|pic=Spirit tree (Construction) icon}} — [[Port Sarim]]. Requires 83 [[Farming]]. * {{Plink|Ring of the elements}} — [[Air Altar]] entrance, north-east of the village. * {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|aiq}} — [[Mudskipper Point]], well south of the village. * Sail and dock there with 18 [[sailing]]. * {{Plink|Teleport to Boat}} — Rimmington [[File:Docking_point_icon.png]] [[mooring point]] once [[Boat|player-owned boat]] with a [[Greater_teleport_focus_(facility)|greater teleport focus]] installed is docked there (requires 18 [[sailing]]). ==History== {{LoreSources|Dragon Slayer I|Guildmaster|dialogue2=yes|the2=yes}} Very little is known about Rimmington's history, but at least one of its residents ([[Melzar the Mad]]) arrived in [[Fifth Age#Elvarg invades Crandor (Year 139)|139]], after the [[dragon]] [[Elvarg]] violently displaced the residents of [[Crandor]]. The [[Guildmaster]] says that Melzar fled "north of Rimmington," possibly indicating that the town already existed at this time. ==Locations== === Stores === {| class="wikitable" !Building !Description |- |[[Rimmington General Store]][[File:General store icon.png]] |A two-story [[general store]] with a shopkeeper and shop assistant. The store rarely has anything of value in it, and is mainly stocked with [[willow logs]] and low level [[items]]. |- |[[Rommik's Crafty Supplies]] [[File:Crafting shop icon.png]] |Located south of the [[Rimmington General Store]]. [[Rommik]] sells supplies useful for [[Crafting]]. His store is exactly the same as the [[Dommik's Crafting Store.|Crafting store]] in [[Al Kharid]]. Players can purchase [[chisel]]s, [[ring mould]]s, [[necklace mould]]s, [[amulet mould]]s, [[needle]]s, [[thread]], [[holy mould]]s, and [[tiara mould]]s from him. |- |[[Brian's Archery Supplies.|Brian's Archery Supplies]] [[File:Archery shop icon.png]] |Located east of [[Rommik]]'s store. [[Brian (Rimmington)|Brian]] sells supplies used for [[Ranged|ranging]]. His store is very similar to [[Lowe's Archery Emporium]] (located in [[Varrock]]), though is much less busy. Players can purchase [[steel arrow]]s, [[mithril arrow]]s, [[adamant arrow]]s, [[oak shortbow]]s, [[oak longbow]]s, [[willow shortbow]]s, [[willow longbow]]s, [[maple shortbow]]s, and [[maple longbow]]s from him. There are also [[rat]]s in his house which can be killed for [[rat's tail]]s for the [[Witch's Potion]] [[quest]]. |} === Buildings === [[File:Handbook- Rimmington.png|thumb|width=300x300|The [[RuneScape- The Official Handbook|Official RuneScape Handbook]]'s page on Rimmington]] {| class="wikitable" !Building !Description |- |Anja and Hengel's house |A house featuring a cooking [[range]] [[File:Cooking range icon.png]] is on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}, with [[Anja]] and [[Hengel]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}. |- |[[Chemist's house]] |Home of the [[chemist]], who plays a role in various quests. |- |[[Crafting Guild]] |A building where players with a [[Crafting]] level of 40 or above can train the skill. |- |Hetty's house |Home of a witch named [[Hetty]], who needs the player's help to [[Witch's Potion|complete her potion]]. |- |[[Melzar's Maze]] |A large, dangerous building that must be entered during the [[Dragon Slayer I]] [[Quests|quest]]. |} === Skill training spots === * There are four [[yew tree]]s ([[File:Rare trees icon.png]]) north-west of the [[general store]]. Behind [[Brian (Rimmington)|Brian]]'s and [[Rommik]]'s stores are dozens of [[willow tree]]s, and there are also some [[oak tree]]s to the east of the village. Because the nearest [[bank]] is quite far away, the trees are not popular for training, but the area may be used as a place to level up [[Firemaking]] by cutting a full [[inventory]] of logs and subsequently burning them. However, there is no space to burn a full inventory of logs in a straight line, hampering training efficiency. * The [[Rimmington mine]] [[File:Mining site icon.png]] north-east of the village contains [[Tin rocks|tin]], [[Clay rocks|clay]], [[Iron rocks|iron]], [[Copper rocks|copper]], and two [[gold rocks]]. * There is a bush [[Farming/Patch locations|farming patch]] [[File:Farming patch icon.png]] north-west of the village. * North of the village is the [[hobgoblin peninsula]], a narrow peninsula with [[safespottable]] [[hobgoblins]], collectable [[sand]], and [[snape grass]] spawns. * The village also includes amenities such as a [[well]] [[File:Water source icon.png]] and a [[Portal (Player-owned house)|house portal]] [[File:House portal icon.png]]. === Other === Off the coast of Rimmington is [[lone oak island]], an inaccessible island with a single [[oak tree]]. === Spawns === {| class="wikitable" !Item !Spawns !Location !Map |- |{{Plink|Bronze arrow|txt=Bronze arrows}} |1 |Brian's Archery Supplies |{{map|2957,3205|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=Bronze arrow}} |- |{{Plink|Bronze pickaxe}} |1 |Anja and Hengel's house |{{map|2963,3216|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=Bronze pickaxe}} |- |{{Plink|Bronze scimitar}} |1 |Anja and Hengel's house |{{map|2965,3211|plane=1|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=Bronze scimitar}} |- |{{Plink|Logs}} |2 |Brian's Archery Supplies |{{map|2958,3205|2959,3205|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=Logs}} |- |{{Plink|Snape grass}} |3 |Hobgoblin peninsula |{{map|2906,3297|2907,3295|2917,3274|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=Snape grass}} |} There is also a small field east of [[Melzar's Maze]], where players can pick [[cabbages]] and [[onions]], and a small patch east of Anja and Hengel's house, where players can pick [[wheat]]. ==Quests== Rimmington is the start point of only one quest, but several other quests require travel to the village: * [[Biohazard]] * [[Dragon Slayer I]] * [[Regicide]] * [[Skippy and the Mogres]] * [[Witch's Potion]] ==Inhabitants== === Personalities === * {{Chatl|Angel}}, the danger-conscious daughter of Anja and Hengel. * {{Chatl|Anja}}, the kind mother who is lightly charitable after enough begging. * {{Chatl|Brian (Rimmington)|txt=Brian}}, a man who sells archery supplies for slightly above average prices. * {{Chatl|Chancy}}, an aptly-named man with a gambling addiction. * {{Chatl|Chemist}}, an intelligent scientist who helps players with quests and impling hunting. * {{Chatl|Cabin Boy Colin}}, a sailor who can take players to the [[Corsair Cove]] after completion of the [[Corsair Curse]] quest. * {{Chatl|Captain Barnaby}}, an old sea captain who can take players to [[East Ardougne]] or [[Brimhaven]] for 30 [[coins]]. * {{Chatl|Da Vinci}}, an aloof artist with a penchant for painting. * {{Chatl|Hengel}}, a man who is surprisingly anti-social for someone who leaves his house's doors open. * {{Chatl|Henja}}, the danger-conscious son of Anja and Hengel. * {{Chatl|Hetty}}, a friendly witch who needs help making a potion. * {{Chatl|Hops (Biohazard)|txt=Hops}}, an aptly-named man with a drinking problem. * {{Chatl|Melzar the Mad}}, a man who escaped the island of [[Crandor]] and hid in Rimmington but was slowly driven to madness in his seclusion. * {{Chatl|Phials}}, Rimmington's [[banknote]] merchant, through whom players train [[Prayer]] by having him un-note [[bones]]. * {{Chatl|Rommik}}, a craftware salesman. * {{Chatl|Shop assistant (Rimmington)|txt=Shop assistant}}, an employee of the [[Rimmington General Store]]. * {{Chatl|Shop keeper (Rimmington)|txt=Shop keeper}}, owner of the Rimmington General Store. * {{Chatl|Taria}}, a gardener who offers the standard functions of all characters who watch over [[farming patches]]. * {{Chatl|Tool Leprechaun|txt=Tool leprechaun}}, a green-clad fellow who can store gardening supplies and note produce. === Monsters === The following monsters can be found in Rimmington: * [[Cow]] (x10) * [[Cow calf]] * [[Hobgoblin]] (x10) * [[Rat]] (x4) The following monsters are also found specifically in [[Melzar's Maze]]: * [[Ghost (Melzar's Maze)|Ghost]] (x5) * [[Lesser demon (Melzar's Maze)|Lesser demon]] * [[Rat]] (x7) * [[Skeleton (Melzar's Maze)|Skeleton]] (x6) * [[Zombie rat]] (x7) * [[Zombie (Melzar's Maze)|Zombie]] (x2) == Music == {| class="wikitable sortable" !Name !
